note: Per request: does dropping to a single measured-yield year raise CV R^2, versus pooling 2022+2023? Climate is excluded from all three fits here (it is constant within a single year and cannot be fit there), so this isolates the effect of sample composition/pooling itself, holding the feature set fixed at cultivar+EBIxcultivar+Growth_April. The full recommended model (which adds climate back for the pooled case) reaches CV R^2=0.456, reported separately in section 22/29.
